content.user_title: Analyze Simulated BTC Trades with SMC
content.value_statement: ICT and Smart Money Concepts analysis can be difficult to apply consistently during a backtest. This skill defines a repeatable BTC/USDT workflow for bias, entry confirmation, risk limits, and recorded reasoning.
actual_capabilities: Determines a 4H market bias and uses 15-minute structure for simulated entries.
Applies liquidity sweep, Change of Character, fair value gap, and order block criteria.
Records TRADE, WATCH, and NOTE decisions with supporting setup reasoning.
Builds simulated orders with entry, stop, target, validity, and position-size guidance.
Sets price alarms for liquidity levels, fair value gaps, order blocks, and structure breaks.
limitations: It is designed for the Alpha Harness backtesting simulation and its documented CLI commands.
It covers BTC/USDT only and uses 4H and 15-minute timeframes.
It does not guarantee profitable results or provide live market data.
Trading decisions remain dependent on the available closed-candle simulation data.

use_cases.title: Practice a disciplined backtest
use_cases.description: Use a fixed analysis sequence before recording a simulated BTC/USDT setup.

use_cases.title: Standardize trading-agent decisions
use_cases.description: Apply explicit trade, watch, and note criteria across repeated simulation sessions.

use_cases.title: Audit setup reasoning
use_cases.description: Capture bias, liquidity, entry, stop, target, and risk logic for later review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simulation review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SMC Harness workflow to review the current BTC/USDT simulation state. State whether the result is TRADE, WATCH, NOTE, or no action.

prompt_templates.title: Check for a valid setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT using 4H bias and 15-minute entry structure. Identify liquidity, a sweep, ChoCH, and any FVG or order block. Only recommend TRADE if every required condition is met.

prompt_templates.title: Create a watch plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WATCH plan for BTC/USDT. Specify the price area, confirmation required, invalidation condition, and alarms to set.

prompt_templates.title: Build an auditable simulated order
prompt_templates.prompt: When a high-confidence BTC/USDT setup exists, document the HTF bias, LTF sweep and ChoCH, entry zone, stop, target, risk calculation, R:R, and order validity. Do not trade without a minimum 2:1 R:R.

output_examples.input: Review the current simulation and decide whether to trade.
output: Reason: Price is approaching sell-side liquidity, but no 15-minute sweep and ChoCH have confirmed.
Next action: Set an alarm at the liquidity level and wait for confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create an auditable long setup after a confirmed sweep.
output: Reason: The 4H bias is bullish, sell-side liquidity was swept, and a 15-minute ChoCH created a bullish fair value gap.
Plan: Enter at the fair value gap, place the stop below the swept low, and target opposing liquidity with at least 2:1 R:R.

best_practices: Use only closed candles available at the current simulation time.
Require 4H bias, a liquidity sweep, and 15-minute confirmation before a simulated trade.
Record the setup thesis, invalidation, and R:R before placing an order.
anti_patterns: Do not enter a trade because price moves quickly without confirmation.
Do not trade against the 4H bias when the setup lacks strong confluence.
Do not exceed the 2% simulated risk limit or open more than one order.

faq.question: What market does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It is designed for BTC/USDT in the Alpha Harness simulation.

faq.question: Which timeframes does it use?
faq.answer: It uses 4H for directional bias and 15 minutes for entry timing.

faq.question: When does it allow a trade?
faq.answer: A trade requires clear HTF bias, a liquidity sweep, LTF confirmation, at least 2:1 R:R, and high confidence.

faq.question: What is a WATCH decision?
faq.answer: WATCH records a forming pattern and waits for the required confirmation before trading.

faq.question: Does it use future price data?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires analysis from closed candles available at the current simulated time.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. This skill documents a backtesting workflow and does not guarantee investment outcomes.
